title: Oozy Peppery Middle Eastern Comte Warak Enab
description: A light and peppery Middle Eastern dish featuring Comte cheese, perfect for a sick day, with a yuzu cure and sugar free friendly ingredients, served in a warak enab form.
instructions: Start by preparing the grape leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
In a large bowl, mix together the grated Comte cheese, yuzu juice, black pepper, and salt.
Add the minced garlic to the cheese mixture and stir well.
Lay a grape leaf flat on a work surface and place a tablespoon of the cheese mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining grape leaves and cheese mixture.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the rolled grape leaves, seam side down.
Pour in the water and bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve the warak enab hot, garnished with additional black pepper if desired.
